title: hakea subterlineata
intro: Hakea subterlineata, commonly known as the Western fringe hakea, is a shrub native to Western Australia. It has been traditionally used by the indigenous people to treat various ailments due to its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The plant is rich in bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its therapeutic actions like antioxidant, antiproliferative, and anti-inflammatory effects. Additionally, the Western fringe hakea has been found to possess potential therapeutic actions, including wound healing, antimicrobial, and antifungal activities, making it a valuable plant in traditional medicine.
